* 183008c19c5bf0487e47ff69705bc38c3a56fd99: Merge pull request #743 from dkatargin/feat/pi-integration (@juev)
* 32929f02d9a4ca716ee54e292dbbd077e421b602: docs(research): count anchors in agent search queries (#746) (@juev)
* dc64254fea8997d349f335af4f63160bd7225274: chore(release): prepare v0.37.1 (@juev)
